optimization_round_24.hypothesis: A soft in-band wall-clock budget reduces adapter timeouts without reducing distinct detection.
optimization_round_24.change: --deadline-minutes inserts a time-budget paragraph in the adapter brief; opt-in.
optimization_round_24.result: timeouts 2 -> 0; success 19/21 -> 21/21; exact F1 .950 -> .977 (one FP); distinct 7/7 both; total adapter wall-clock 5468s -> 2592s (-53%).
optimization_round_24.caveat: Sequential runs, not a simultaneous A/B; provider variance cannot be fully excluded, but the mechanism directly targets wall-clock.
